audit.why: Lane difficulty is stated accurately: Aatrox owns levels 1-5, Kassadin survives. Emerald+ 58.33% over 12 games is a scaling win rate, not a lane win rate, and the level chart giving Aatrox 6/7 stages is the honest shape of this matchup rather than a contradiction. Left the chart alone and sharpened the text instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 6/11/16 spike line used a vague 'fifteen-second invitation' and never named what actually changes at each level.
audit.why: Riftwalk's cooldown is 5/3.5/2 seconds at ranks 1/2/3, which is the entire reason levels 6, 11 and 16 are spikes. Aatrox's own spike is World Ender at 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now names the 5s -> 3.5s -> 2s Riftwalk progression; breakdown.cooldowns names World Ender's 120/100/80.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent. (1) Deathbringer Stance deals bonus MAGIC damage and heals off the target's max health - so Null Sphere's magic shield and Void Stone's magic reduction do absorb it, while the page said only 'the Q shield blocks none of his AD'. (2) Infernal Chains only drags you if you are still inside the impact area, so a 500-range Riftwalk out of the circle cancels the second hit entirely.
audit.why: Riot's own text: 'Periodically, Aatrox's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage and heals him, based on the target's max health' and 'Champions and large monsters have to leave the impact area quickly or they will be dragged to the center and take the damage again.'
audit.corrected: Added to content.early, content.spikes[1].text, full.report[5].t and full.loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers at all.
audit.why: Infernal Chains is 20/18/16/14/12s - the longest punishable window in his kit; the pull-into-sweetspot pattern is gone for a full wave once it misses.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with World Ender 120/100/80 and Infernal Chains 20s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Add anti-heal early' had no timing attached.
audit.why: Umbral Dash heals passively on any champion damage and World Ender grants increased healing, so Grievous Wounds has to be online before the second-item window, not 'sometime'.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now pins anti-heal to before your second item and names both sources.

audit.whatIsWrong: Force Pulse charging was described as a liability in every lane.
audit.why: Force Pulse draws energy from spells cast in Kassadin's vicinity, and Aatrox's abilities are free-cost and spammed - so his own casts charge your E for you here.

edits.before: His drain-tank mode — never take a long fight into it. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: His Darkin Blade sweetspot stops short of Null Sphere's 650 - farm from that edge.

edits.before: Aatrox burns World Ender on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Riftwalk goes 5s to 3.5s at 11 and 2s at 16 - each rank is a new lane.

edits.before: - Aatrox World Ender: matchup-defining — His drain-tank mode — never take a long fight into it. Check it before every step-up. - Q shield is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - World Ender: 120/100/80s, his only real kill window - count it before you step up. - Infernal Chains is 20s at rank 1; once it misses, the pull-into-sweetspot is gone for that wave. - Umbral Dash heals him for damaging you at all.

edits.before: His R combat-stat all-in is his kill window on you; Riftwalk at 6 is only an escape blink here, not a fight — your Q shield is magic-only and blocks none of his AD.
edits.after: World Ender is his kill window and Riftwalk is your exit, not a fight. Chains only drag you if you are still inside the circle - blink out before the second hit lands.

edits.before: His Eclipse/Goredrinker spike lands while you stall on Catalyst/Rod of Ages — your weakest gap; never stand in Infernal Chains range for a CS or he Q-chains you down.
edits.after: His first-item spike lands while you stall on Catalyst/Rod of Ages - your weakest gap. Chains reach 825, past your 650 Q, so take that CS from outside it or not at all.

edits.before: Concede everything here — I cannot fight an Aatrox who out-trades me with sweetspot Q knockups and a passive that heals him on every hit, while my Null Sphere is a single short-range nuke that drains my mana pool dry. I last-hit at Q's max range and lean on Nether Blade to refund mana whenever I can safely auto a minion. Do not count on my Q shield to save a trade — it only absorbs magic damage, so it blocks none of his physical Q/W. The one thing to fear is his Infernal Chains setting up the Q sweetspot — never stand where the pull drags me into his knockup.
edits.after: Concede everything here - Aatrox out-trades me with Darkin Blade sweetspots while Umbral Dash heals him for damaging me at all, and my Null Sphere is one short-range nuke that drains my mana pool dry. I last-hit at Q's 650 range and lean on Nether Blade to refund mana whenever I can safely auto a minion. My Q shield absorbs magic only, so it blocks none of his physical Q/W/E - but it does eat Deathbringer Stance, the periodic proc that heals him off my max HP. Fear Infernal Chains setting up the sweetspot - never stand where the 825-range pull drags me into his knockup.

edits.before: Riftwalk gives me an escape, not a fight — his R combat-stat all-in still kills me and my magic-only Q shield blocks none of his AD, so I blink away.
edits.after: Riftwalk is an escape, not a fight - World Ender's attack damage still kills me and my magic-only Q shield stops none of it, so I blink out of the chain zone.

edits.before: Full kit and still underpowered — E only charges when spells fly, so passive lanes starve your waveclear too.
edits.after: Full kit, still underpowered - but Force Pulse feeds on spells cast near you, and his free-cost Q and E charge it.

edits.before: - Kassadin vs Aatrox - Track: Aatrox World Ender. - No trades before 6 — not one. - No commits into World Ender. - The ultimate closes arguments; it doesn’t open them.
edits.after: - Kassadin vs Aatrox - Track: World Ender, 120s at rank 1. - No trades before 6 - not one. - Blink out of the Infernal Chains circle before it drags you back.

edits.before: Track Aatrox’s World Ender: His drain-tank mode — never take a long fight into it. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Deathbringer Stance is magic - your Q shield eats it. Chains drag you only if you are still inside when they pull.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield or Ring by lane. Tear early, Rod of Ages into Mercs or Sorcs, then Seraph's Embrace and Zhonya's. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield. Tear early, Rod of Ages into Mercs, then Seraph's and Zhonya's. Anti-heal before your second item - Umbral Dash and World Ender both scale it.

notes: FLAG MISFIRE: _missing-interactions.json says 'Aatrox can deny your mobility (Riftwalk) with Infernal Chains (W)' from a derived grounding flag, but Riot's description of Infernal Chains has no grounding - it slows and drags. I did not write a grounding claim; I wrote the drag mechanic instead. Same file's 'Aatrox can cancel your Null Sphere (Q) with World Ender (R)' comes from a channel flag on Null Sphere that also misfires - Riot's text says Null Sphere INTERRUPTS channels, it is not one. Not written. Level chart left at Aatrox 6/7 despite the 58.33% flag: that win rate is Kassadin's scaling, not his lane, and inventing a lane stage he does not win would mislead.
